title: How can a boat travel uphill?

props.title: A barge in front of a canal lock

a11y.description: A small barge floats in the lower canal, in front of a lock: a stone chamber closed by black wooden gates. Beyond the far gates, the upper canal lies about 3 metres higher than the boat.

props.textAlternative: **Text version of the scene.** A small [barge](glossary:barge) floats in the lower canal, in front of a [lock](glossary:lock): a stone [chamber](glossary:lock-chamber) closed at each end by a pair of black wooden [gates](glossary:gates) with white-tipped [balance beams](glossary:balance-beam). Beyond the far gates, the upper canal lies about 3 metres higher than the boat, behind a wall of stone.
